Phish or Legit?

The Email Detective Game. Ten emails, one locked word. Read the headers, check the records, and decide like an investigator.

Start a case

Choose an email set
Shown on screen and on your results.

How to play

  1. You play an employee on a busy Thursday. Read all 10 emails in the mailbox.
  2. Investigate like a security analyst: hover over links, open ⋮ → Show original to read the headers, and check SPF, DKIM, DMARC, domain age and links with the Lookup panel.
  3. Mark every email Phish or Legit. You can change your mind until you submit.
  4. Every email ends with an Answer Hint letter. The letter tray collects letters only from emails you marked Phish, in email order.
  5. Unjumble the tray letters into a word and submit it. All 10 emails must be marked first. After 5 wrong tries there is a 30-second pause.
  6. Nothing here goes online. Links, buttons and QR codes never open, and every lookup runs inside the game.
